review.tagline: Gradient boosted decision tree library for tabular machine learning
review.summary: XGBoost implements parallel tree boosting (GBDT/GBM) under the gradient boosting framework. Per the README, the same code runs on Kubernetes, Hadoop, SGE, Dask, Spark and PySpark, and scales to billions of examples. It is distributed through PyPI, CRAN and conda-forge.
review.audience: Data scientists and ML engineers training models on tabular data
strengths: Same code runs on Kubernetes, Hadoop, SGE, Dask, Spark and PySpark
Packaged on PyPI, CRAN and conda-forge
Backed by a KDD 2016 paper; Apache-2.0 licensed
Active: release on 2026-09-15 and recent commits
weaknesses: Tree boosting only; not a general deep learning framework
README does not state GPU support, RAM needs or language bindings
README has no install or quick-start example; relies on external docs
Aimed at tabular data; no LLM or generative model support
